g.text: Registered automobiles per 100 street parking places, by postal area (FSA): Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce and its neighbours, 2024
Automobiles and light trucks registered in the City part of each FSA (SAAQ, December 31, 2024; type inferred) per 100 places of legal curb, at 5.37 m a place.
The limiting case in which every registered automobile is kept on the street: it is not a measure of how full the streets are or of how hard parking is.

g.text: H4B: 73 · H4A: 68 · median of the 49 ranked FSAs: 73 · all 49 together: 70

Legal curb: each block face of the City’s géobase (local streets, collectors and arterials), less 10 m at each end, less the stretches where a sign forbids stopping or parking at all times; an upper bound (driveways, hydrants, bus stops, hourly,

permit, street-cleaning and seasonal rules are not deducted). Vehicles kept off the street, visitors and vehicles from elsewhere are not counted. At 5 m a place every value is 7 % lower, at 6 m 12 % higher; the order of the FSAs does not change. An
FSA shared with another municipality is shown for its City part (automobiles whose record gives Montréal).

Sources: SAAQ, vehicles released under the access Act (file 03.06.34729); City of Montréal, géobase, inventory of parking signs, administrative limits, electoral districts (CC BY 4.0). FSA boundaries: DMTI Spatial, CanMap Postal Code Suite v2024.3.
